# How many employees does Blue Triangle have?

Blue Triangle Technologies, Inc. has approximately30 total employees worldwide as ofMarch 2026, according to Revelio Labs workforce intelligence data.Blue Triangle’s total headcount has declined35.8% from 46 employees in 2023 to 30 in 2026.

Data source: Revelio Labs•Coverage: Global workforce, 2023–2026•Published August 2026

## Is Blue Triangle hiring right now?

Yes, Blue Triangle isactively hiring. Blue Triangle had3 active job postings in 2026, a 200.0% increase from 2025— [see job openings & hiring trends](https://www.reveliolabs.com/companies/blue-triangle/employees#postings).

## About Blue Triangle’s Workforce

Blue Triangle Technologies, Inc. is an Information Technology Services company that employs **30** people worldwide as of March 2026. It is the 11th-largest by headcount among its [peers](https://www.reveliolabs.com/companies/blue-triangle/employees#similar-companies). Founded in 2011, the company is headquartered in Mechanicsville, Virginia.

Blue Triangle's workforce has declined **35.8%** from 2023 to 2026, down **3.6%** year over year in 2026. It fell to a low of **29** in 2025 Q3 before recovering. Its workforce is concentrated most in North America ( **78.2%**), followed by Northern Europe ( **13.0%**) and Southern Europe ( **4.9%**).

Blue Triangle's functional groups are Engineering ( **43.1%**), Sales and Marketing ( **30.8%**), and Finance and Operations ( **26.1%**), with Finance and Operations growing fastest (up **10.8%**). The average salary is **$152,359,** highest in North America at a median of **$181,000,** up **2.7%** year over year in 2026.

Blue Triangle's active job postings rose **200.0%** in 2026 to **3**, with new postings per month climbing from **1** in 2023 to **2** in 2026. Overall employee sentiment is negative and declining.
